title: Navimower 0.4.3-beta51

## Diagnostics

- Add safe per-host diagnostics for the shared-account `auth-list` bootstrap fallback used when private mower login returns no uid.
- Record only host, vendor code/description, response container type, item count and first-item key names.
- Do not log uid, mower serial, tokens, device id or other payload values.

## Purpose

This prerelease is intended to identify why accepted US shared accounts still fail to bootstrap a private-cloud uid after `0.4.3-beta50`.
